user_query: I'm a fashion enthusiast and I'm looking for some trendy outfits for an upcoming event. Can you recommend some stylish dresses and accessories that are in fashion right now? It would be great if you could provide user reviews and ratings for these products. Additionally, I need information about the latest fashion trends and designers.

TaskList.description: Retrieve current fashion trends and popular designers to understand the latest fashion landscape.
Search for trendy dresses and accessories based on the latest fashion trends.
Gather user reviews and ratings for the recommended dresses and accessories to assess their popularity and quality.
